scope: scripts/qualify_plcsim_gaps.py on a frozen Debug build of e38adf2 (artifacts/gs3), 73/73 steps, on one owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU1511 instance on Softbus of an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 with a central DI 16x24VDC HF, an ET 200SP IM 155-6 PN ST station on the CPU's IO system, GapDb (counters, IEC TON, DTL), Main and interrupt OBs 40/82/83/86 imported with their event classes; card download, credential provisioning, power on and RUN as in the D09 runner. change.simulation_download_online (compile=false, save=false, runtime-user login, TLS never trusted): a Main change downloads with softwareScope changes and keepActualValues in RUN (ConsistentBlocksDownload answered, a kept counter 7, ProgramVersion 2); a GapDb layout change with keepActualValues answers TIA's DataBlockReinitializationOrKeepActualValues with KeepActualValues and keeps 7; a further layout change with reinitialize and allowStop answers StopPlcAndReinitialize, resets the counter to 0 and returns to RUN; plc_online_compare afterwards reports FolderContentsIdentical; refusals without a ticket, reinitialize without allowStop and compile/save=true. sim_test runs a 5 s TON scenario on the wall clock (5.97 s) and twice with virtualTime (TimespanSynchronized_C, 13 and 14 StartProcessing spans, 5.90 s virtual, previous mode restored); sim_time scaleFactor 10 completes the timer within 1.25 s of wall time and is restored to 1; systemTimeUtc 2031-06-15 is read by RD_SYS_T as year 2031. sim_event raises OB82 (diagnosticAlarm, +1), OB83 (pull and plug, +2) on the DI module and OB86 (station fault and return, +2) on the ET 200SP IO device, each changing only its own counter; a malformed event refuses before the runtime call. sim_state memoryReset restarts with start values and the downloaded program. sim_storage archives the powered-off card (791 737-byte zip with receipt), refuses a wrong hash, retrieves it with an unchanged ownership marker, and the retrieved card runs the online-downloaded program. The instance is released with deleteOwned.
limitations: One owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU1511 instance on Softbus of a scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1, provisioned with first-use TLS trust under the owned-empty-CPU policy; other CPUs, firmware and TCP/IP instances are not qualified.

OB40 is a V21 boundary: V21 Openness exposes no channels and no hardware-interrupt attribute on the DI module, so no hardware interrupt is configured and PLCSIM answers ProcessEvent with NotSupportedByModule (-55); OB40 does not run. statusEvent on the central DI module is answered NotSupportedByModule as well (OB55 is for distributed modules).

Virtual-time scenarios at scale factor 1 run at wall-clock speed in deterministic StartProcessing spans; the speed-up comes from scaleFactor, and the combination of both is not exercised. Scan-exact timing is not claimed.

Each online download must start within the 15-minute ticket from sim_create; after a program change PLCSIM answers NotUpToDate until its tag list is refreshed with sim_tags. Archive and retrieve restore the same state that was archived; a cross-state restore is not exercised.
